translated: I even used to go by myself back in the day.
I haven't really been able to go these past few years, though.
I usually go around summer, like September, so I've never been when the autumn leaves are in full bloom.
It's hard to time it right, isn't it?
It depends so much on the weather that year.
I heard it's supposed to be a bit warmer in the west this year, so the timing might shift around.
But even if the maples haven't changed color yet, the greenery is still beautiful.
I'm not sure if Potato-san will get to see them or not...
Well, even if they don't see them this year, I'm sure the scenery will still be wonderful.
I don't know how old they are, but...
